payload.name: Door-in-the-face technique
payload.fact: The door-in-the-face technique involves making an extreme request that is refused, followed by a smaller request, which increases compliance with the smaller request compared to asking for it alone.

provenance.title: Reciprocal concessions procedure for inducing compliance: The door-in-the-face technique.
provenance.quote_or_locus: In each instance, this procedure produced more compliance with the smaller favor than a procedure in which the requester asked solely for the smaller favor
